remarks: Fifth floor one bedroom deluxe Type F layout in the premier Tamarack Club. Fractional ownership of this unit gives you 10-11 rotating weeks per year, or about 1 week per month. You have the option to use the units, rent the units, or a combination of both. You can also use half of the unit while renting our the other, so rental opportunities are increased. Ownership amenities include year 'round access to the heated indoor/outdoor pool, two hot tubs, sauna, fitness center, private locker rooms, private owners lounge, valet parking and underground parking while lodging overnight. Owner discounts are available on daily lift tickets, Sky High Aerial Adventure Park and golf as well!
